title: PR 3bc — purchases engine (AP at entry) + every reader, one deploy

goals.text: Every bill posting (create at_entry, pay, partial pay, void, void payment, amend) and the legacy at_payment pay goes through lib/purchases on the ledger writer: balanced, closed-period gate, idempotent replay on (tenantId, sourceType, sourceId); route-level wiring tests assert the journal lines of each bills route and each call into lib/purchases is mutation-checked.
Bills feed AU BAS 1B/G10/G11 and CA line 108 from their line data: accrual by billDate, cash GST by AbBillPayment.date pro-rata (golden fixtures incl. partial payments and a quarter boundary).

For an accrual tenant with purchases_at_entry on (globally or by per-tenant allowlist in FeatureFlag.metadata.tenantIds), a new bill posts DR category net | DR 2100 recoverable | CR 2000 gross on its bill date; a cash-basis tenant never does.
Paying an at_entry bill in full or in part posts DR 2000 / CR 1000 and creates no expense row; overpayment is 422; concurrent payments cannot overpay.

at_payment bills and cash-basis tenants pay exactly as before (DR expense / CR 1000) through the writer with a real payment sourceId, a period gate and no silent fallback account; DELETE of a paid bill is refused; soft-deleted bills are 404 on GET/PUT/PATCH. Unflagged tenants are proven with the REAL flag module (no row / metadata absent / other tenant listed). Prod evidence on every default run: tests/e2e/mobile-app/bills.spec.ts 'bills legacy at_payment (control, never flagged) - jordan' (manifest goals take vitest files only; the e2e is in launch.prodPlaywright).
Every reader treats open|partial as unpaid (bills GET, aging, Home, Upcoming, CPA run, manage-bills, cpa-review); the balance sheet balances for mixed legacy/new bills and counts no bill twice.
?basis=cash is disabled with a localized banner (Reports) and a Settings basis note while open at_entry bills exist.
GET purchases returns one row per bill with a Due/Paid badge among expenses; the mobile Docs list and the desktop expense list render it, and a paid bill is never an expense row.

launch.rollback: First lever, no deploy: turn the flag off (`npx tsx agentbook/enable-purchases-at-entry.ts --remove --apply`, or `--global off --apply`); new bills are created at_payment again. Bills already posted at entry keep their balanced journals (DR expense/2100, CR 2000) and stay payable/voidable, since pay/void/amend dispatch on each bill's postingMode, not on the flag. Full rollback: revert the PR; the additive bill columns (lines, payments, postingMode, paidCents, revision, deletedAt) stay and are ignored. Before a revert, void or pay out any open at_entry bills, because the pre-PR pay route would post a second DR expense for them.
